title: Editor Node Authoring Roadmap Docs Retirement Checklist

items.label: Capture the Project Control documentation authority policy and Editor owner before cleanup.
items.evidenceTarget: Work path, owner repository, active role, Phase target, Checklist target, and Evidence target are identified before editing Editor Markdown.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > flowdoc-documentation-authority-cleanup, owner repo-editor, active role documentation-synthesizer, phase target phase-flowdoc-documentation-authority-cleanup-editor-node-authoring-roadmap-retirement, checklist target checklist-flowdoc-documentation-authority-cleanup-editor-node-authoring-roadmap-retirement, and evidence target evidence-editor-node-authoring-roadmap-docs-retired-2026-08-31.

items.label: Write a failing Editor documentation authority guard before deleting files.
items.evidenceTarget: The focused Editor documentation authority test fails before the roadmap pair is retired.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence included npm run test -- src/tests/editorDocumentationAuthority.test.ts failing because docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-30-editor-node-authoring-roadmap.md still existed.

items.label: Retire exactly the old node-authoring roadmap plan/spec pair.
items.evidenceTarget: Editor commit deletes the two node-authoring roadmap docs/superpowers files and no other product-repository Markdown is deleted in this slice.

items.label: Guard surviving Editor docs/superpowers files with Authority Boundary wording.
items.evidenceTarget: Remaining docs/superpowers Markdown files declare Project Control authority, local/historical scope, and non-evidence status until later migration or retirement.
items.verificationNote: Editor AGENTS.md points Markdown work to docs/domains/flowdoc-documentation-authority-policy.md, and the focused guard asserts surviving docs/superpowers Markdown contains Authority Boundary, Project Control, and not product evidence wording.

items.label: Verify the Editor worktree and merged main gates.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused docs tests, Editor worktree npm run check, and merged Editor main npm run check pass after cleanup.
items.verificationNote: Focused Editor docs gate passed 3 files and 8 tests. Editor worktree and merged main both passed npm run check with type-check, 110 test files, 396 tests, and build.

items.label: Record the cleanup in Project Control without promoting product truth.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control evidence cites the Editor commit, files, verification, deleted paths, residual cleanup risk, and boundaries intentionally not promoted.
items.verificationNote: Evidence is work-scoped with nodeIds [] and keeps Core, Backend, Editor, compatibility, frontend readiness, FlowDoc product truth, and map truth unpromoted. A post-cleanup status check showed tracked Core deletions under packages/text-engine-rust-wasm; they were restored from Core HEAD and Core status returned clean.
